text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Difference in quantile score between two arms, in points of capacity. The dashed line at zero means the two arms score the same. 16 Primary substations; 73 forecast runs, one every 5 days, July 2025 to June 2026. Arms with ERA5 residuals use ERA5 weather at past times, so they are an upper bound on production. Dot: estimate. Line: 98.75% interval (planned contrasts) or 95% (exploratory) from re- drawing whole months and seeds.'
